column_description: TEXT. Unique monitoring record key. PK. Example: FA410087.
TIMESTAMPTZ. Snapshot timestamp. **NULL means snapshot timestamp not recorded.**. Example: 2024-08-21T08:30:21.
TEXT. Account reference for monitoring. FK to accounts.
TEXT. Source of detection. Possible values: Algorithm, Manual Review, Pattern Match, User Report.
REAL. Detection confidence score. **NULL means detection confidence not recorded.**. Example: 0.132.
TEXT. Monitoring priority. Possible values: High, Low, Medium, Urgent.
TEXT. Investigation state. Possible values: Active, Completed, Pending.
TEXT. Action taken. **NULL means no action recorded.**. Possible values: Restriction, Suspension, Warning.
TEXT. Review frequency. Possible values: Daily, Monthly, Quarterly, Weekly.
REAL. Confidence score. **NULL means confidence score not assigned.**. Example: 0.253.
TEXT. Model version used. Example: v1.5.
TEXT. Feature version used. Example: f1.7.
BIGINT. Update frequency in hours. Example: 3.
